recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球胞質內布滿粗大、深紫紅色的中毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），核分葉較少（約三葉、葉間較粗），在使用 G-CSF 的病人即為典型的藥物刺激效應。
features: Single neutrophil with cytoplasm densely filled with coarse dark purple-red (toxic) granules
Nucleus with two to three lobes connected by relatively broad bridges (hyposegmented appearance)
No distinct Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles identified in this cell
Background red cells normocytic with some elliptical forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with prominent coarse, dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granulation and a nucleus with few lobes joined by broad chromatin bridges. Dohle bodies and cytoplasmic vacuolization are not evident in this cell. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. In a patient receiving granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect; infection or sepsis can produce identical toxic granulation and should be clinically excluded.

ddx.dx: Toxic granulation due to sepsis or inflammation
ddx.vs: Sepsis produces morphologically identical granulation, often with vacuolization and Dohle bodies; distinction depends on clinical history of G-CSF administration.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark inclusions present in all leukocyte types including lymphocytes and monocytes, independent of infection or cytokine therapy.
Chediak-Higashi cells contain a few giant, irregular fused granules rather than numerous uniformly coarse fine-to-medium granules.
